Kalbaryo ng Maralita

IN PHOTOS │A mother cradles her child while joining the Kalbaryo ng Maralita (Calvary of the Urban Poor) on Holy Tuesday. A wooden cross draped in white cloth is carried through the streets, symbolizing the burden of displacement and loss.

The procession takes on deeper meaning as it passes through the NIA Road “ground zero,” the site of a March 6 fire that left more than 4,000 families homeless. For many participants, the Lenten ritual is both an act of faith and a form of protest.

📸: Edd Castro
